title: Assigning harbour pilots to arriving vessels
brief: Ships calling at our port must take a harbour pilot. A shipping agent files a pilotage request for a vessel's arrival. The duty dispatcher checks the request, assigns a pilot and confirms the boarding time. Vessels carrying dangerous cargo need the harbour master's approval before the boarding is confirmed. A pilot whose licence has lapsed must never be assigned. A pilot may be assigned only after eight hours of rest, although in busy periods any available pilot may be assigned immediately.
